translations.M. Pickthall (English): And if ye bring him not unto me, then there shall be no measure for you with me, nor shall ye draw near.
translations.Yusuf Ali (English): "Now if ye bring him not to me, ye shall have no measure (of corn) from me, nor shall ye (even) come near me."
